Egg hand-off and the escape branch

Editorial overview: Gigi's recorded quest nodes branch on whether the player has two large eggs, then continue through the hand-off, police escape and return conversation.

The egg check and later escape nodes are recorded build references. The site does not execute inventory or police conditions.

Two-egg check to the documented hand-off

Editorial overview: Conversation 51 keeps the choice node, the two-egg branch, the escape cue and the post-escape hand-off.

  1. Gigi

    Hey, {PLAYER_NAME}! You made it. Do you have the eggs?

    Node: 51/42 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

    • Have two large eggs
    • Fewer than two large eggs
  2. Player

    Yes, 2 large eggs, both organic.

    Condition (shown as recorded, never executed): The source condition requires at least two large eggs.

    Node: 51/43 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

  3. Player

    Working on it!

    Condition (shown as recorded, never executed): The source condition is fewer than two large eggs.

    Node: 51/44 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

  4. Gigi

    Perfect. Thank you. This helps more than you know.

    Node: 51/45 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

  5. Gigi

    I have joined Vitalis Labs so I can run real tests. I want the truth in the open.

    Node: 51/46 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

  6. Player

    You really think it is that serious?

    Node: 51/47 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

  7. Gigi

    Yes. We are seeing odd fractures in shells, strange hatch rates, and residue that does not belong in healthy feed cycles.

    Node: 51/48 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

  8. Gigi

    Do you hear that?

    Node: 51/49 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

  9. Gigi

    They are close. Someone tipped them off about the handoff. WE HAVE TO RUN!

    Node: 51/50 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

    We made it, {PLAYER_NAME}. Clean drop. I think the drones peeled off.

    Node: 51/55 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

    You good?

    I am good. The eggs are intact.

    I will get these into the cold room, then start tests tonight.

    Node: 51/58 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

  14. Player

    What happens next?

    Node: 51/59 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

  15. Gigi

    Node: 51/60 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

    Node: 51/61 · Recorded dialogue excerpt

  17. Player
